text:
lina: FYI support flagged a tenant claiming the deprecation banner forced them to upgrade to v2 in the console, but our routing traces show their traffic was still served by v1. They're worried about unexpected quota and invoice deltas.

matt: can you paste the trace + billing event? want to see which field metering used.

lina: snippet:
```
ts=2025-06-20T15:03:12Z tenant=acme req=zz99 header=X-API-Version=v2 router_decision=redwood-v1 exec=ok billing.event: model_tag=client:v2
```
so billing event tagged client:v2 while router_decision indicates v1.

nora: we intentionally added the deprecation banner last week to nudge clients to v2. the banner sets the console version_badge but shouldn't affect billed model. looks like some paths still use client tag for billing.

julian: legal asked: if we change historical invoices we need an audit trail and customer opt-in/out policy. small reconciliations are OK, but mass rewrites require billing signoff.

matt: proposed path: 1) run a dry-run reconciliation for last 30 days, produce delta report per tenant 2) for deltas > 2% or $50, flag revenue-ops and tenant owner 3) do not auto-write invoices; instead surface a "reissue preview" and allow opt-in writeback.

nora: ops concern: we need a low-noise mode for customers on enterprise contracts. they may prefer quiet correction rather than an inbox alert. legal says quiet corrections ok if below contract thresholds, but must be documented.

lina: how do we detect which billing events used client tag vs router_model? we can reprocess raw events and use precedence: router_model > billing.field.billed_model > client_tag.

matt: reprocess plan: use raw_events S3 partition, map by req, recompute attribution, aggregate per-tenant. output columns: tenant, window_start, old_tokens, new_tokens, delta_tokens, pct_delta, est_delta_dollars.

nora: add an "enterprise_quiet" flag: tenants with enterprise_quiet=true will get only a preview report to their account rep; other tenants receive an email if pct_delta>1%.

julian: audit trail requirement: all recalculations must produce an append-only CSV in billing-audit bucket and a human-readable summary stored in /runs/reconciliations/<run_id>/summary.md. Include signed-off-by metadata.

matt: tech notes: routed_model arrives as router events; sometimes router emits decision after exec due to pipelining. join window of 15s should catch most cases. memory calc: at 80k rps worst-case, buffer for 15s => ~1.2M entries; we must cap to 5s for prod but keep a fallback approach: best-effort join then use heuristics for late-arrival. We'll simulate.

lina: UX ask: for console banner copy, add a tooltip: "This banner is guidance only. Actual billed model may differ due to runtime fallbacks. See attribution mode in billing view." reduces confusion.

nora: also expose a console toggle for "show billed-by: routed_model/client_tag" so customers can preview both. default stays client_tag for now to avoid mass surprises.

ops-bot: ticket created: BILL-1298 "reconciliation-run-30d-and-enterprise-quiet-mode" assigned to @matt and @nora. (https://redwood.internal/tickets/BILL-1298)

julian: comms: draft message to affected tenants should include sample line items and a help link. keep language: "preview only; no charges changed yet". compliance wants 30-day retention for previews.

matt: timeline: PR for pipeline join + dry-run job by EOD, perf sim tomorrow, dry-run report generation in 48h, then review with revenue-ops. we will not write invoices without legal signoff.

lina: thanks all. i'll coordinate tenant previews with support once we have the CSVs. post links here. :white_check_mark:
